proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#1
proposed.text: Davis serves under Mack once Mack becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

changes.evidence: Daisy names Mack to lead S.H.I.E.L.D. in S5#22 'The End'. In S6#1 'Missing Pieces' S.H.I.E.L.D. is rebuilding under Mack and Davis is one of its agents searching space for Fitz; in S6#9 Mack and Davis raid Izel's ship together. So the boss stage holds from S6#1, not S6#10. Izel possessing Davis and dropping him to his death is S6#10 'Leap', which moves to a new later stage (see next change) so S6#1 does not spoil it.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#10
proposed.text: Izel possesses Davis to get inside the Lighthouse, then drops him from a ledge and kills him before jumping into Mack.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An agent under Mack's command, until Izel possesses and kills Davis.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Davis's Director, until Izel possesses and kills Davis.

changes.evidence: S6#10 'Leap': the team learns Izel infiltrated the Lighthouse through Davis; she hops between agents until she drops Davis from a ledge, killing him, before taking Mack. Companion to the S6#1 move above; card lines are the current stage's lines.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#11
now.text: Izel takes Elena hostage and jumps into her body as she works to open a gateway for her kind.
now.on_a_card_about_b: One of Izel's hostages and hosts.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Takes Elena hostage and possesses her.

changes.evidence: S6#10 'Leap': when Yo-Yo and Daisy confront Izel, Yo-Yo lets herself be possessed and Izel, in her body, makes Mack fly her away. So Izel first jumps into Elena and takes her hostage in S6#10. In S6#11 'From the Ashes' Mack and Yo-Yo are already Izel's prisoners at the temple.
